svg.text: THE CASE STAGE 1 HAS TO REPRODUCE
Rigidly supported spherical dome · Mekjavić & Pičulin (2010), Table 1
E = 32 GPa · C30/37 · bottom edge fully fixed
thickness drawn ×8; everything else to scale.
B · why the edge needs its own mesh
the edge disturbance decays as e^(−βψ), with β = [3(1−ν²)]^¼ √(r/t) = 22.0,
so it is spent 7.8° from the edge — 3.9 m of a 14.1 m meridian.
ψ, from the edge to the apex
lines: the closed-form membrane solution. circles: the paper’s
finite-element values, fine mesh. The gap at ψ = 0 is the whole
reason a shell tab needs a mesh that is finer at its edges.
N in kN/m, M in kNm/m.
This is the acceptance test for Stage 1.
Published numbers, an analytic solution beside
them, and a mesh study that converged at 12 028
elements. If the element cannot hit this, nothing
built on top of it is worth drawing.
